trigger: 03 GT4 large black foreground region. Per-draw pixel history identifies original draw 142 replacing BGR [30,33,26] with black before butterfly draws 146/147.

diagnostic.forcedFlush: Investigation only; not used for performance acceptance.

rootCause: Native VP DP3 writes large negative lighting values into raw TBUF3, routed to primary color. Missing normalization of dedicated color interpolators lets those values reach half ADDs and DST_COLOR/ZERO multiplication, turning the rock black.
implementation: Saturate only the final routed front/back primary/secondary color outputs before rasterization. Keep raw TBUF arithmetic and texture-coordinate interpolators unrestricted.

sources.supports: Legacy pixel color inputs saturate to [0,1].
NV30/40 driver does not advertise unclamped vertex colors; API-to-native mapping is corroborating evidence, not a newly decoded hardware control bit.

regression: Real GPU primary and secondary colors clamp endpoint values -1/3 before interpolation (pixels 12,52 after quarter-scale); texture-coordinate route preserves signed and >1 values (pixels 0,143). Entire real GPU suite and Closure passed.

nativeRerun.source: Same coherent GT4 checkpoint used by pixel diagnosis
nativeRerun.observation: Foreground rock texture visible beneath butterfly; large black region removed. Full 03 image/reference gate remains open.
